summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the newsletter feature (register opt-in, admin users listing/toggle, newsletter compose/send/history). 15/15 pytest cases pass on the public URL. All Playwright UI flows on /inscription, /admin/users and /admin/newsletters work end-to-end including persistence after reload, filter buttons, empty-form validation, confirm dialog, success toast, form reset and history entry.

issues: Missing space between number and label: renders '4comptes' and '1abonnés newsletter'. Fix by adding a whitespace between the count <span> and the label <span> (e.g. add ' ' or `mx-1`). Purely cosmetic.

action_items: Optional cosmetic: add spacing between count and label spans in UsersAdmin stat cards (users-total, users-subscribers) so it reads '4 comptes' and '1 abonnés newsletter'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1200 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, admin, newsletters, analytics) for maintainability.

POST /api/newsletters iterates over up to 5000 subscribers and adds one BackgroundTask per recipient synchronously calling requests.post; for larger lists this will be slow and blocks Resend rate limits. Consider batching or using async httpx + gather.

GET /api/newsletters/subscribers-count and other admin routes return 401 (not authenticated) instead of 403 when no token is provided — this is standard, just be aware the review request wording said 403 for 'requires admin' but only 403 is returned when a *user* token is present; missing tokens yield 401 (correct behavior).
In UsersAdmin.jsx the toggle does optimistic update but ignores the returned newsletter value; fine for now.
seed_data_creation: Created a few throwaway users (email prefix test_nl_ / test_ui_nl_) and one TEST_UI newsletter during testing; all cleaned up from Mongo after run (verified 2 users + 1 newsletter deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Newsletter feature is fully functional end-to-end. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_newsletter.py. Cleanup pattern used: delete users where email starts with test_nl_ or test_ui_nl_, and newsletters where subject starts with TEST_. Do NOT touch aymenkssi@yahoo.fr — it is a real user.
